$comment: drain.mqInfraSignatures: nonempty array of regex source strings for same-head failed_checks job-log infrastructure evidence. Standard default: ["could not fetch \S+ from promisor remote"]. Resolve standard → platform drain → tool drain → WE_DRAIN_MQ_INFRA_SIGNATURES (JSON array), logging effective value and source through policy-cascade. Sources must parse entirely as ASCII letters, digits, spaces, escaped ASCII punctuation, or the wildcard tokens \S+, \d+, \s+ only. Require at least 10 ASCII alphanumeric characters and at least 11 literal letters/digits/spaces, at most two wildcards, and no adjacent wildcards. A non-space wildcard must be followed by a space, escaped punctuation, or end; a whitespace wildcard by a non-space or end; a digit wildcard by a non-digit or end; compile-check every source. Unknown syntax is rejected; invalid overrides fall back to the next valid layer. At most 32 sources, 200 characters each. At most ten failed jobs; more jobs or unreadable/empty/non-text logs hold with operator inspection. Log exec uses maxBuffer=4 MiB and scans only the final 256 KiB of returned text (UTF-8 bytes); scan each newline-delimited line only within its last 2000 characters. A signature outside these bounds cannot authorize retry; operators must inspect failed jobs and enqueue manually when no infrastructure evidence remains. The existing single-retry, CLEAN PR and newest-completed-green-main requirements remain in force.
